Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.
Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.
Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

As a Sales Development Representative, your primary responsibility will be to secure meetings with top prospective companies and individuals. You'll work closely with one paired Account Executive to generate meetings from their target account list.

We encourage account development through outbound prospecting, social selling, networking, attending conferences and field marketing events, and any sales activity that would contribute to expanding the Tremendous brand.

You will be the first line of engagement with prospective customers and will have an impact on Tremendous’ revenue growth and future success.

Work primarily to bring in new deals through Outbound prospecting.
Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing and Customer Success teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business.
Use Outreach, LinkedIn, your own network, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging.
Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

2-3 years of prior sales experience, ideally in a similar outbound or SDR role.
Clever and creative problem solving. We're small and emphasize output and iteration over a sales handbook set in stone.
Independence. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.
Collaboration. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.
Ability to thrive with a well-set quota. We want our goals to be fair and achievable. You should find these goals alongside your team and with your manager and use them as a benchmark for success.
Ambition. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. We’re profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. That’s good news for your career growth.

Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.
Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

If you're ambitious, curious, and ready to grow fast in a company that's scaling across Europe, this is where you start.

Qualify leads effectively by understanding each business's needs, challenges and goals — and matching them to the right Mollie solution
Own the full sales cycle for smaller businesses, taking deals from first contact through to close
Route high-potential leads to the right Account Executives with clean, well-documented handovers that set the next stage up for success
Build pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, complementing inbound work with proactive engagement
Keep CRM records accurate and up to date, and feed insights back to Sales and Marketing to help sharpen our acquisition strategy

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.
No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.
Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.
If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line, is expanding its Talent Acquisition function in support of its continued growth in the US market. We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead hiring for high-impact, business-critical, and leadership-level roles across the organization.

This role requires deep full-cycle recruiting experience, a strong track record of improving recruiting processes, and a thoughtful, data-driven approach to talent strategy.

This person will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders and play a key role in attracting and securing exceptional talent for some of the company-s most important hires. **This role is based within commuting distance of downtown Miami and requires 4 days per week in office.**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for critical roles across the business, including high-profile leadership positions.
* Build strong relationships with hiring managers and senior leaders, serving as a trusted Talent Acquisition partner and advisor.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to understand talent needs, shape job descriptions, and develop effective recruiting strategies. Provide data-driven recommendations on how to attract and assess top talent.
* Use recruiting metrics and analytics to track key performance indicators such as time-to-fill, quality of hire, source of hire, and candidate conversion rates.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR leadership to streamline and optimize hiring processes.
* Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to build strong pipelines of qualified candidates. Leverage a mix of traditional and innovative sourcing channels, including social media, job boards, employee referrals, networking, and direct outreach, while using data to refine strategy and improve results.
* Conduct proactive talent mapping, market research, and competitive benchmarking to inform search strategy and stay ahead of industry trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor hiring practices.
* Lead in-depth candidate screening and interview processes to assess qualifications, leadership capabilities, and overall fit.
* Leverage data and feedback to optimize candidate engagement, reduce time-to-hire, and enhance the overall candidate experience.
* Lead the offer process by advising hiring managers on compensation, negotiating complex offers with senior candidates, and ensuring a smooth transition from offer acceptance through onboarding.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and professional experience for candidates throughout the hiring process. Provide timely feedback and keep candidates informed at every stage.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting and/or executive recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for complex, business-critical, and leadership-level roles from manager through SVP.
* Significant in-house recruiting experience within a high-growth, large-scale, or fast-paced environment, with proven success leading searches across functions such as sales, marketing, procurement, IT, and other strategic corporate areas.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage recruiting data and analytics to identify trends, generate insights, and improve hiring outcomes. Strong proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools, with experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruitment analytics platforms.
* Deep experience developing targeted sourcing strategies and engaging high-caliber talent through multiple channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking, and direct outreach.
* Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including experience conducting competency-based, behavioral, and situational interviews to evaluate leadership capability, organizational fit, and long-term potential.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex insights in a clear and actionable manner, influence senior stakeholders, and represent the company credibly with candidates.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority searches simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and a high bar for candidate quality.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems such as SuccessFactors, Workday, or Greenhouse, as well as recruiting analytics platforms such as LinkedIn Talent Insights, Google Analytics, or similar performance-tracking tools.
